name: Practice Fusion MCP Server
description: Enables interaction with Practice Fusion EHR through 19 healthcare tools for patient management, appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and document handling. Supports both local and remote access with OAuth2 authentication and structured data resources.

rawRecord.description: Enables interaction with Practice Fusion EHR through 19 healthcare tools for patient management, appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and document handling. Supports both local and remote access with OAuth2 authentication and structured data resources.

HTTP_HOST.description: HTTP server host (restrict to localhost unless external access needed)

HTTP_PORT.description: HTTP server port (only used when TRANSPORT_TYPE=http)

PF_SCOPES.description: API scopes (space-separated list of required OAuth scopes)

PF_CLIENT_ID.description: Practice Fusion API Client ID (required, get from Practice Fusion Developer Support)

PF_CALLBACK_URL.description: OAuth callback URL for local development

PF_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Practice Fusion API Client Secret (required, get from Practice Fusion Developer Support)

HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS
